job_spec.structural_change:
REFILL-2/S81 (10-21) parallel fallbacks of dsdv_sh_lk_s10g / s10h: k-means regional CTS (clock_split_km.tcl).

Why: the s10g / s10h --cts gates (10-21 04:25 / 04:36) FAILED only clock_rule: 14,318 sinks on one TritonCTS root,
pin-flop spread TT 147.2 / FF 129.9 ps (s10g) and TT 171.4 / FF 146.2 ps (s10h) > 80.  Fix (same recipe that took the
COLL lanes s8n 121.6 -> s8nk 83 ps): split the ck port net into K compact sink clusters with one local root each under a
balanced top tree.  q = K 24, r = K 32.  Same RTL, outline, macros, pins, PDN, layer contract and cycles.

--- s10h base ---
S81-SHLK-1021 successor of s10f (route b0972fda0 FAIL: daemon sign-off TT +13.8 / FF hold -20.6 on 31 pins / DRC 19 M4 shorts; the ORFS raw -273 ps / 1449 hold paths is the unreferenced 166.7-ps input min-delay against ~450 ps propagated insertion, not the judged number). All 19 shorts sit on the MY-mirrored left-column macros' centre-facing pin face (x = edge - 0.5..1.5 um, M4): the m1 masters carry ~10 pins/um on their 39-44-um side faces (> SAFE 6/um), so the router jogs inside the 1-um OBS gap. Fix: Codex p192 contact-pitch masters (accd38c70; same behaviour/bodies, 0.192-um pin pitch = 5.2 pins/um, 76.968 / 86.136 um tall; PG straps pulled back 1.5 um as the _pa views) selected by OT_S81_SH_P192 (default off, no RTL behaviour change, no added cycle), outline grown for the taller macros, hold repair margin 30 -> 60 ps. S81-SHLK-1021 s10h (parallel, enlarged channels): same p192 masters at x 43.2 (MY) / 259.2 (R0), y 43.2 / 194.4 / 324.0: 116.9-126.6-um centre channel, 65.1 / 52.6-um row channels, 52.6-um N band; outline 388.8 x 453.6 (176,360 um2, fill ~31%).
